components.css: .ds-material{max-width:250px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e3dc);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#242522);transition:border-color 160ms ease-out;font-family:"Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", system-ui, sans-serif;}.ds-material:hover{border-color:#b5bcaa}.ds-material:has(input:checked){border-color:#ac843c;box-shadow:none}.ds-cover{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:#eceee7}.ds-cover-button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#747e69;cursor:pointer}.ds-cover-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#966d20);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-cover-button:hover{background:transparent}.ds-film-icon{width:35px;height:35px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-material-select{position:absolute;left:9px;top:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:29px;height:29px;background:#fffffff0;border-radius:4px}.ds-material-select input{width:16px;height:16px;margin:0;accent-color:var(--accent,#966d20);cursor:pointer}.ds-material-select input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#966d20);outline-offset:3px}.ds-duration{position:absolute;bottom:8px;right:8px;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:3px;background:#333b31d9;color:white;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-material-body{padding:10px 11px 11px}.ds-material-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:550}.ds-material-info{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#686a65)}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-cover{aspect-ratio:4/3}.ds-material-body{padding:9px}.ds-material-name{font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-material{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
留白编排 is a quiet working surface: a narrow white rail, an off-white canvas, charcoal Chinese UI type and restrained warm-gold actions. Source covers carry the visual attention; the interface supplies compact controls, thin separators and a clear next step rather than a promotional composition.

This scan-mode specification records the emitted CSS, including the approved-composition overrides after the older component rules. It follows the user-selected code-led model-pick sketch and direction contract, not a generated raster comp. The supplied wheat/infinity logo remains the exact original image; the brand is not redrawn or substituted. Native Chinese UI sans is an intentional Operate exception to expressive display typography.
keyCharacteristics: White narrow navigation and open horizontal tooling.
Moderate landscape covers with compact metadata.
Warm gold for deliberate action and active state; semantic colors for outcomes.
Flat working layers, contained media and native stateful controls.

rules.name: The Restrained Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold identifies primary actions and active context; failed, warning and completed outcomes retain their distinct semantic families.

rules.name: The Native Legibility Rule
rules.body: Use the shipped local Chinese UI stack; keep functional text at or above the implemented 11px floor and preserve the established heading hierarchy.

rules.name: The Covers First Rule
rules.body: Keep source covers moderate and landscape, controls compact and working space available; enlarge the number of visible materials rather than turning covers into tall posters.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary working surfaces with tone, spacing and fine borders; reserve pronounced elevation for dialogs and transient feedback.

rules.name: The Existing State Rule
rules.body: Preserve native dialogs, details, hidden and ARIA state contracts, media controls, field constraints and the existing three workflow steps.

dos: Do use the supplied original brand image and the exact 量禾混剪 name; the ICO is a deterministic resource conversion, not a redesigned mark.
Do use the final approved override values when earlier declarations conflict; CSS cascade order is part of this extraction.
Do retain compact failure rows with complete details in the existing dialog, and keep background music in its existing expandable location.
Do preserve the existing IDs, form/input contracts, confirmations, APIs and data paths when applying the visual system.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and contained actual-video previews.
donts: Don't replace the white navigation rail with a dark-navigation concept.
Don't add sorting options, a third source tab, a help link or demo functionality from the decision sketch.
Don't add font-CDN dependencies, GSAP choreography, page-load animation or marketing motion to this local working UI.
Don't crop actual video previews, stretch source covers into portrait posters or hide the complete task error behind truncation alone.
Don't treat fixture screenshots, frontend contracts or the visual ship verdict as verification of paid media production or shortcut deployment.
